In Beijing, China, more and more people take the subway or share bikes, because it is cheap and eco-friendly.

passage: Do you know how animals spend the winter? Different animals have different ways to stay warm and safe during the cold months. Many birds don't like the cold winter. In autumn, they fly away to the warm south, where they can find a lot of food. When spring comes and it gets warm, they fly back to the north. This is called migration. Some animals like bears and squirrels choose to sleep through the whole winter. This is called hibernation. Before winter comes, they eat a large amount of food to get fat. During the winter, they stay inside their warm caves or holes and sleep.
